t: You are at Belsize Park station, on the Edgware branch of the Northern line, between Hampstead and Chalk Farm. It sits in fare zone 2, in the London Borough of Camden. The station was designed by Leslie Green, who died young, in 1908. He is best known for the iconic Underground stations he designed in central London in the first decade of the twentieth century. They have distinctive oxblood red faience blocks, with pillars and semicircular first-floor windows, and patterned tiled interiors in the Modern Style. Look for those features as you take in the building.
